description: Create a new User Group (Team) in a Workspace with an initial set of members. Returns the created group with its id and handle. Use to organize people for mentions and bulk assignment.

handle.description: Optional @-handle for the group (used for mentions). Defaults to one derived from the name.

members.description: User ids to add as initial members of the group.

name.description: Display name for the new User Group.

team_id.description: Team/Workspace ID. Falls back to CLICKUP_TEAM_ID when omitted.

name: create_user_group
